parameters.name: CredentialConfig
parameters.description: The chained authorization configuration. This parameter is optional. For more information, see [Use chained authorization to access resources of other entities](~~465340~~).

parameters.name: Interval
parameters.description: The interval for video snapshots, in seconds. The value can be an integer from 1 to 600. The default value is 1.

parameters.name: MaxFrames
parameters.description: The maximum number of frames that can be captured for this detection task. The value can be an integer from 5 to 3,600. The default value is 200.

parameters.name: Notification
parameters.description: The notification configuration. For the format of asynchronous notification messages, see the metadata index section in [Asynchronous notification message format](~~2743997~~).

parameters.name: ProjectName
parameters.description: The name of the project. For more information about how to get the project name, see [Create a project](~~478153~~).

parameters.name: SourceURI
parameters.description:
The OSS URI of the video.

The OSS URI must follow the format oss\://${Bucket}/${Object}. `${Bucket}` is the name of the OSS bucket in the same region as the project. `${Object}` is the full path of the file, including the file name extension.

parameters.name: Tags
parameters.description: Custom tags used to search for tasks.

parameters.name: UserData
parameters.description: Custom information that is returned in the asynchronous notification message. Use this information to associate the notification message with your internal system. The maximum length is 2,048 bytes.
